title: Flat sections on affine subopens imply tensor flatness
statement: Let Y be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and G a sheaf of structure-sheaf modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], not assumed quasi-coherent. Suppose that for every pair of affine opens U contained in V, G(U), with scalars restricted along O_Y(V) to O_Y(U), is flat over O_Y(V); this is the full affine condition IsFlatOver G (identity Y) [def-pc-scheme-module-flat-over]. Then tensoring sheaves of modules with G is exact, i.e. G is tensor-flat [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules].

source.place: Modules Tag 05NE; Algebra Section 10.39, Lemma 10.39.3 (Tag 00H9), and localization flatness Tag 00HT

proof.text: Apply the affine-local stalk-flatness lemma to obtain flatness of every stalk of G over its stalk ring.

For an exact short complex, apply the exactness criterion for stalks. At each stalk use the stalk tensor isomorphism and flat-module tensor exactness; naturality identifies the resulting complex with the stalk of tensoring by G. Therefore tensoring preserves exact short complexes, hence homology, finite limits and finite colimits.
